rent.note: furnished 1BR ('2 pièces') in Mermoz / Ngor-Almadies / Point E ~570,000 FCFA (monthly listings 500k–650k; Numbeo unfurnished 1BR centre 475k). FX 583 XOF/USD

utilities.note: Orange fibre 100 Mbps 24,900 FCFA + electricity/water ~50,000 FCFA (estimate: about half Numbeo's 118,944 FCFA 85 m² figure; A/C drives Senelec bills). Many furnished lets include some of this

groceries.note: home cooking; local markets cheap but imported staples (dairy, cheese, cereals) are expensive — milk ~1,500 FCFA/L

diningOut.note: derived: 10 local meals x 3,000 FCFA + 2 mid-range meals (31,000 FCFA for two) + 12 cappuccinos x 1,975 FCFA + extras ≈ 100,000 FCFA (Numbeo, 18 contributors)

transit.note: derived: ~20 BRT/DDD rides at 400–500 FCFA + ~12 Yango/taxi rides at ~2,000 FCFA; BRT does not reach Almadies, so taxis dominate for expats

coworking.note: hot desk ~60,000–65,000 FCFA/month (Impact Hub from 60,000; Jokkolabs 65,000 in 2021); Regus Almadies is pricier

simData.note: Orange Pass Internet mois 25 GB = 5,000 FCFA plus a little call credit

accomSeasonality._doc: 12 monthly multipliers for RENT ONLY (Jan..Dec). Editorial: dry-season (Nov–Mar) visitor and short-stay expat demand firms furnished rents; the Jul–Sep rainy season is softest. Dakar's furnished market is mostly business/expat driven, so the swing is modest.
